parole.testo: From Proto-Ugric *θarańa (“gold, copper”), earlier *sarańa, compare Komi-Zyrian зарни (zarńi, “gold”), Eastern Mansi тарань (taranʹ), Eastern Khanty лорня̆ (lornjă, “copper”), Erzya сырне (sïrne). The Ugric word is probably a borrowing of Iranian origin, compare Avestan 𐬰𐬀𐬭𐬀𐬦𐬀 (zarańa), Old Persian
